title: 第242章 罗酆山第241章 离开
content_zh:
“士卒也好，江湖散人也好，若是不找些事情给他们做，闲久了就容易惹事生非。”
“士卒倒是还好，不外乎让他们多操练，但江湖散修，想要让他们安分守己，却是不易。”
“像这种号召修士，抓捕一位八品盗贼的事情，再合适不过了。”
南冥王眸光瞥了燕飞龙一眼：“他的修为不高也不低，正是一个练手的好目标。”
“重赏之下，必有勇夫。那些不怕死的，往往才是最让朝廷头疼的。”
“对朝廷也好，对江湖散修也好，死一个偷天门门主，换来一段时间的安稳，何乐而不为？”
燕飞龙沉默了。
他的确没想到，当初能在王府顺利偷走【昴日星玉】，而后被整个南境修士追杀，背后竟是这样的原因。
过了好一会儿，他忍不住问道：“如果我当初不管不顾，为了活命，把所有追上来的人都杀了呢？”
“那些八品修士，我或许无法尽杀，但以我的修为，那些七品修士在我面前，绝无活命的可能。”
“更何况，还有那些通风报信的五品六品……你一条悬赏令，不知要死多少人。”
南冥王淡漠地道：“那样的话，朝廷的压力也能减少许多。”
燕飞龙心神一颤，眸光透过白焰，怔怔的看着这位南冥王。
真是好狠的计策啊！
他要是真在江湖上胡乱杀戮，正好把那些修士杀掉一批，反倒是在给南境的治安贡献力量。
哪怕他不滥杀，可那些为了贪功夺利者，为了取他的头颅，可以相互争夺，彼此厮杀，无形之中，江湖死了多少人？
而今想来，这位南冥王只是随便发一条悬赏令，此后数年之内，南境江湖都将安静一段时间。
燕飞龙面露苦涩。
再怎么说，他也怪不到南冥王的头上，毕竟是自己主动撞的枪口。
而且，他也忽然明白，南冥王为什么不听辩解，执意要砍他的头了，正是为了震慑宵小。

一石二鸟！
姜峰深深的看了南冥王一眼。
真不愧是从皇宫里培养出来的。
哪怕姜黎不是皇子，可他从小跟在姜言身边，耳濡目染之下，也学到了不少治民之法。
这样的人，说一句心狠手辣，倒也不为过。
可站在尸蛮国朝廷的角度，南冥王此举也是为了南境安稳。
要是再狠一点，他完全可以借用这个事情，私底下将那些不服管教的江湖帮派，全都杀了个干净，然后把罪恶推到燕飞龙身上。
到时候，再把燕飞龙的脑袋一砍……直接万事大吉！
一行人走到南境边境，姜峰停下脚步，没再往前。
南冥王也没问姜峰为什么停下。
只是站在原地，深邃的眸光，眺望着远方。
约莫等了一个时辰。
遥远的天边，倏尔出现两道疾速飞行的身影。
南冥王只是朝那边看了一眼，便回过头去，不再关注。
早在昨夜，他便收到天子传来的密令，要他即刻返回帝都，勤王保驾。
当时，他正在大殿内，与姜峰商谈，述说那些断断续续的回忆，对于身上那枚不停颤动的传讯令，置之不理。
那时候他便知道，姜峰已经派人去了帝都。
content_en:
"Whether it's a soldier or a layman, if you don't find something to do for them, they will easily get into trouble if they are idle for a long time."
"The soldiers are fine. It's just a matter of letting them practice more. But it's not easy for the casual cultivators to keep them in order."
"It's very appropriate to call on monks to arrest an eighth-grade thief."
Nan Ping Wang glanced at Yan Feilong: "His cultivation level is neither high nor low. He is just a good target for training."
"Under heavy rewards, there must be brave men. Those who are not afraid of death are often the most troublesome to the court."
"Whether it's good for the court or for the casual cultivators, why not do it if the leader of the Stealing Heaven Clan dies in exchange for a period of stability?"
Yan Feilong was silent.
He really didn't expect that there was such a reason behind being able to successfully steal the [Pleiades Star Jade] from the palace and then being hunted down by the entire southern monks.
After a while, he couldn't help but ask: "What if I didn't care at first and killed everyone who caught up with me in order to survive?"
"I may not be able to kill all those eighth-grade monks, but with my cultivation, those seventh-grade monks have no chance of surviving in front of me."
"What's more, there are those fifth and sixth grade people who tipped off the news... I don't know how many people will die if you issue a reward order."
Nan Pluto said indifferently: "In that case, the pressure on the court can be reduced a lot."
Yan Feilong's heart trembled, and he looked at the Nan Pluto King blankly through the white flames.
What a ruthless strategy!
If he really kills randomly in the rivers and lakes, he will just kill a group of those monks, but he will contribute to the security of the southern border.
Even if he doesn't kill indiscriminately, those who are greedy for power and profit can fight and kill each other to get his head. How many people have died invisibly?
Now that I think about it, this Nan Pluto just issued a reward order casually. In the next few years, the Jianghu in the South will be quiet for a period of time.
Yan Feilong's face showed bitterness.
No matter what, he couldn't blame Nan Pluto on the head, after all, he took the initiative to hit the muzzle.
Moreover, he suddenly understood why Nan Ping Wang refused to listen to the excuse and insisted on cutting off his head, just to scare Xiao Xiao.
Kill two birds with one stone!
Jiang Feng took a deep look at Nan Pluto.
It's true that he was trained from the palace.
Even though Jiang Li is not a prince, he has been with Jiang Yan since he was a child and has learned a lot about how to govern the people.
It is not an exaggeration to say that such a person is ruthless.
But from the perspective of the Corpse Man Kingdom's court, Nan Pluto's move was also for the stability of the southern territory.
If he had been more ruthless, he could have used this incident to privately kill all the disobedient Jianghu gangs, and then put the blame on Yan Feilong.
When the time comes, chop off Yan Feilong's head... and everything will be fine!
When the group reached the southern border, Jiang Feng stopped and did not go any further.
Nan Ping Wang did not ask why Jiang Feng stopped.
He just stood there, looking into the distance with his deep eyes.
Waited for about an hour.
In the distant horizon, two rapidly flying figures suddenly appeared.
Nan Ping Wang just glanced over there, then turned back and stopped paying attention.
As early as last night, he had received a secret order from the emperor, asking him to return to the imperial capital immediately and have King Qin escort him.
At that time, he was in the main hall, discussing with Jiang Feng, recounting those intermittent memories, and ignored the trembling summons on his body.
At that time, he knew that Jiang Feng had sent people to the imperial capital.
